Theorem
[Cheeger--Yau lower bound] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0334 1. ch16:16.3\group Heat Kernel Bounds

If $(M^n,g)$ is complete with $\operatorname {Rc}\ge 0$, its positive heat kernel satisfies \[ H(x,y,\tau )\ge (4\pi \tau )^{-n/2} \exp \! \left(-\frac{d(x,y)^2}{4\tau }\right). \]
